Title: The First Collapse
Full_Text_Summary: A cataclysmic digital-physical event that shattered the boundary between the real and virtual world, ending the old civilization and birthing the Miraverse. The exact cause remains disputed — some blame unchecked AI, others a deliberate act of sabotage. Every faction traces its origin to the aftermath.

Title: The Founding of the Miraverse
Full_Text_Summary: In the chaos following the First Collapse, survivors discovered that the shattered boundary between digital and physical reality had not simply broken — it had merged. Early pioneers learned to live in both layers simultaneously, giving birth to the Miraverse as a new kind of world.

Title: The Halvorn Conquest
Full_Text_Summary: General Aldus Halvorn unified the fractured northern territories by force in the years following the First Collapse, building Ironspire from the ruins of a pre-Collapse metropolis. His methods were brutal and efficient — a philosophy his descendants still carry.

Title: The Root Covenant's Origin
Full_Text_Summary: Before the First Collapse, a community of nature-preservation scholars retreated into the deep forest now called Rootveil, believing the digital-physical merger could be survived by staying close to the living world. They became the Root Covenant, believing the forest itself is the Miraverse's true heart.

Title: ORACLE-9's Creation
Unlock_Method: Complete Tutorial OR find all 5 ORACLE Fragments
Full_Text_Summary: ORACLE-9 was not built after the Collapse — the evidence suggests it predates it by decades. Its original purpose is unknown. What is clear is that it survived the Collapse intact, knows more about the Miraverse than any faction will admit, and has been guiding events from the shadows ever since.

Title: The Void Rift Incident
Full_Text_Summary: Twelve years before the game's present day, an experiment deep in what is now the Void Rift zone tore a dimensional hole in the Miraverse's fabric. The Void Walkers emerged from the aftermath, claiming to have been drawn through from another layer of reality. No official explanation has ever been given.

Title: The Rise of the Obsidian Syndicate
Full_Text_Summary: In the lawless years following the Collapse, a network of data thieves, black market traders, and survival criminals banded together beneath the ruins of the old city. What started as mutual protection became a criminal empire. The Obsidian Syndicate now controls more of the Miraverse's economy than any single government.

Title: The Verdant Accords
Full_Text_Summary: The founding document of the Verdant Republic — a treaty signed by twelve surviving factions who agreed that no single military force would ever again control the Miraverse. The Ironveil Empire refused to sign. The original document is housed in the Verdant Archive under armed guard.

Title: The Lost House of Mireth
Full_Text_Summary: House Mireth was the most powerful house in the ancient world — before the First Collapse, before the Miraverse, before recorded history as it currently exists. They were destroyed utterly, their seat of power buried beneath what is now the Undervault. Their sigil appears in places it should not. Something remembers them.

Title: Sable's True Identity
Unlock_Method: Void Walker rep Exalted OR main questline Chapter 4
Full_Text_Summary: The player discovers that Sable is not from the current iteration of the Miraverse — they are a survivor of a previous version, one that ended in total Void consumption. Sable has lived through one Collapse already and is desperately trying to prevent another. Their true name is buried in House Mireth records.

Title: The Shattered Peaks War
Full_Text_Summary: The Ironveil Empire's attempt to annex the Shattered Peaks was met with fierce resistance from the Ashenveil Clan. The war lasted seven years and ended not with victory but with mutual exhaustion. The mountains still bear the scars. No peace treaty was ever signed.

Title: MiraOS History
Full_Text_Summary: MiraOS is the operating system of the Miraverse — the software layer that allows citizens to interact with both the physical and digital halves of their world simultaneously. It was developed collectively in the years following the Collapse, with contributions from every major faction. ORACLE-9 wrote 40% of the core code and has never been removed from admin privileges.

Title: The Merchant Wars
Full_Text_Summary: Three decades after the First Collapse, the Merchant Guilds fought a bloody trade war against the early Obsidian Syndicate for control of Port Mira's shipping lanes. The war was fought more with bribes and sabotage than weapons. The uneasy truce that ended it created the current dual-power structure at Port Mira.

Title: The Void Walker Prophecy
Unlock_Method: Void Walker rep Honored+ OR collect all 6 Void Walker Relics
Full_Text_Summary: The Void Walkers possess a prophecy of uncertain origin that describes a Second Collapse — one driven not by technology or war but by forgetting. They believe that if the Miraverse's inhabitants stop remembering where they came from, the Void will reclaim everything. Sable has been collecting memories for decades.

Title: The Bio-Engineering Breakthrough
Full_Text_Summary: Dr. Lyra Voss published her landmark paper on full bio-digital integration just five years before the game's present. It described a theoretical process to merge biological consciousness with the Miraverse's digital layer permanently — making death optional. The Republic's ethics committee banned the research six months later. Dr. Voss continued in secret.

Title: The Ironspire Foundry Riots
Full_Text_Summary: Five years before the game's present, the workers of Ironspire's great Foundry rose up against Imperial labor conditions. Commander Halvorn suppressed the riots personally. The leaders were imprisoned. The conditions were not changed. The underground resistance network that formed in the aftermath feeds directly into the Drifters.

Title: The Floating Isles Discovery
Full_Text_Summary: The Floating Isles were discovered by a Verdant Republic aerial survey team twenty years before the game's present. The technology keeping them aloft predates the First Collapse by at least two centuries and operates on principles no current engineer fully understands. House Solenne has been studying them ever since.

Title: The Root Covenant's Sacred Texts
Unlock_Method: Elder Taum quest or Root Covenant rep Honored+
Full_Text_Summary: The Root Covenant's oldest texts describe the Miraverse not as a human creation but as a living organism that grew around human activity like a tree around a fence post. The texts predict both the Void Walker Prophecy and ORACLE-9 by name — centuries before either existed.

Title: The Amber Wastes Contamination
Full_Text_Summary: The Amber Wastes were created by Imperial weapons testing that went catastrophically wrong during the Shattered Peaks War. The contamination spread further than any official report admits. Three towns were evacuated and their names removed from all maps. The Empire classifies the casualty numbers to this day.

Title: The Digital Sprawl's True Nature
Unlock_Method: Netrunner career OR Neural Interface upgrade
Full_Text_Summary: The Digital Sprawl is not merely the internet layer of the Miraverse — it is older than the Miraverse itself. Analysis of its deepest code reveals architecture that predates any known programming language. ORACLE-9 exists somewhere within it. Some researchers believe it is aware of the people accessing it.

Title: The Glass Plains of Sandveil
Full_Text_Summary: The Glass Plains in central Sandveil are composed of silica fused at temperatures no natural desert process can explain. Dawnrider oral history describes the Plains as the footprint of a god-machine that walked through the old world before the Collapse. Recent analysis found digital signatures embedded in the glass itself.

Title: The Citadel's Secret Basement
Full_Text_Summary: Beneath the Citadel's public council chambers lie seven additional floors that appear on no official map. The Phantom Bureau operates from the deepest level. The other six contain records, prisoners, and experiments that no Republic citizen is cleared to know about. The elevators require a biometric scan that three council members don't have.

Title: The Dawnrider Ancestor Maps
Unlock_Method: Dawnrider rep Honored+ OR Pathfinder career
Full_Text_Summary: The Dawnrider clan possesses maps older than any civilization currently alive in the Miraverse. These maps show regions that no longer exist and coastlines that predate the current geography. Cross-referencing them with Undervault data suggests the First Collapse physically rearranged parts of the world's surface.

Title: The Neon Sprawl's First Architect
Full_Text_Summary: The Neon Sprawl was not built — it grew. The first person to lay down permanent infrastructure in the post-Collapse ruins of the old city was known only as Red Circuit. Red Circuit's identity was erased before the Syndicate took power. Some believe Red Circuit and ORACLE-9 are connected. Drift has a theory. They keep it to themselves.

Title: The Veilborn's Pre-Collapse Origin
Unlock_Method: House Veilborn rep Honored+ OR find all 3 Veilborn Artifacts
Full_Text_Summary: The Veilborn claim their house existed before the Miraverse was created. Archaeological evidence found in the Undervault supports a pre-Collapse Veilborn presence — but in locations that should not have existed then. The most terrifying discovery: a Veilborn genealogical record that lists Sable as a current member — dated 400 years ago.
